messages:
sam (SEO): Quick sync — building the SEO execution checklist for the May product + webinar push. Need owners for: keyword mapping (priority buckets), schema/microdata snippets for webinar & launch pages, internal link weight plan (hub pages -> feature pages), redirects plan (old docs -> new docs), and inbound lead routing (gated webinar -> CRM). Who can take what? :memo:

maria (Growth): I can own webinar landing messaging + gating UX. Will work with Ryan on meta/title/snippet tests. :rocket:

ryan (Content): I'll do keyword map and meta tests. Can paste initial CSV by EOD. Quick Q — do we want CTAs canonicalized per product line or global CTA? leaning per product line.

sam (SEO): per product line for tracking. Also needs schema: Event + FAQ + Organization microdata on landing. Alex — can infra enable structured data testing hook in staging for the page?

alex (Platform): Yeah — can add a test endpoint that returns the rendered HTML for Googlebot. I can also run the structured data test after deploy. Need PR by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ryan (Content): CSV snippet:
```csv
url,primary_kw,secondary_kws,priority,owner
/launch,large-language-model-inference,latency;cost,1,ryan
/webinar,production-llm-inference,webinar;best-practices,2,ryan
/docs/migration,redirect-playbook,redirects;canonicalization,3,ryan
```
I'll attach full file in #marketing-assets.

maria (Growth): For redirects — prefer 301s for permanent pages, 302 only for temporary A/Bs. Sam — can you draft redirect map? I'd like redirect window to be tested in staging for 48 hours before prod.

sam (SEO): drafted a starter redirect map. Key notes: consolidate three /guides pages -> /docs/migration (301); preserve query params for campaign tracking (?utm_src=...); keep a short-lived 302 for /beta-signup -> /webinar-register during A/B. Also add canonical tags on old versions.

jordan (Sales): Heads up — gating webinar with lead form needs proper UTM->CRM mapping. Maria, can you share required lead fields? We need mapping to get MQL attribution.

maria (Growth): Jordan — need name/email, company, role, use-case checkbox. Also hidden field for campaign_id and landing_variant.

alex (Platform): deploy-bot: scheduled preview deploy for staging at 2102468200.

deploy-bot: build succeeded. live preview at http://staging.redwood.test/launch-preview. Tests: structured-data-check: pending. :robot_face:

sam (SEO): action items: Ryan - full kw csv + meta snippets by EOD (owner=ryan). Maria - gating UX + field mapping (owner=maria). Alex - staging preview + schema test (owner=alex). Sam - redirect map + canonicalization plan (owner=sam). We'll reconvene 2102468299 (10min). :clock10:

maria (Growth): :thumbsup: catching up on campaign calendar — I'll add to Marketing Launch board and tag people.

ryan (Content): On it. Starting keyword clusters now.
